text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *cough cough*!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh, stop making a fuss over every 
little thing. I just coughed a bit, that's 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: More importantly, about our training—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like it's getting a bit 
repetitive. Like my body has already 
gotten used to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If aiming for victory at the Kikuka Sho, 
this is the time where we really need to 
level up significantly.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chaaaan!! Let's go do sand sprint 
training together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Ticket-zo-san! Um, are you sure you 
want me!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Of coooooourse!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If we do it together, it'll be full power 
× full power for super full power, and I 
can bring out waaaay more strength...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's do it togetheeeer! Uwoooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-san...! Understood, let's do 
this! Uooohh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so stifling...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Taishin hesitated, but I felt like 
I understood what she was trying to say."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with someone else should be great 
for breaking the monotony.
choice_data_list: Want me to go find you a training partner?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Just so you know, there's no guarantee 
we'll find it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is, well, like that, and Hayahide 
said she wanted to train alone this 
summer, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Don't blame me if everyone turns you 
down, saying there's no point practicing 
with a squirt like you.
choice_data_list:
There's no one who'd say things like that 
to you anymore.

There's no one left who would say such 
things to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having produced stellar results in the 
Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), she is now counted among the "Big 
Three" shaking up the Classic front.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that within Tracen Academy, at 
least, there probably isn't a single 
person who doubts Narita Taishin's 
ability—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ............Do whatever you want.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll go look for it!
Alright, I'll go look for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, running all over the beach, the 
candidate we found for a practice partner 
turned out to be—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, build power by splitting 
watermelons? Don't tell me you're doing it 
barehanded?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no way~! I'll just use a bat 
normally~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, looking at you, you look way less 
like you're training and totally like a 
girl making the most of summer.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, Rice-chan, that's amazing, 
amazing!! You brought so many tires!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! I wanted you to pull me a 
lot... to build up my guts...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now then, which girl should I ask...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
W-Watermelon splitting? How is that even 
training—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome, Taishin-san~! I'll do the work 
first, so please give me instructions!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Direct them...!? Th-That's so sudden...
choice_data_list:
Just pretend you're controlling a game 
character!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, blindfold secure~. Shall we get 
started, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Two steps to the right! Then three 
steps forward... Too far, one and a half 
steps back!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And—attack!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Taishin-san! Your 
instructions were super easy to follow~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nature set up the watermelon over 
there for us to eat, so let's go~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, smashing it with a bat made a total 
mess... Wouldn't it be better to just cut 
and eat it normally?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, isn't it strange~? Even though the 
watermelon looks weird, for some reason it 
tastes even better than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Taishin enjoyed a rather 
pleasant summer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Taishin-san... Are you really sure it's 
okay for us to do this together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though being around Rice... might 
bring you bad luck...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What kind of logic is that...? I mean, I'm 
the one who asked for it in the first 
place.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So... um. ...I look forward to working 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-Yeah! We're counting on you...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, training progressed smoothly, and 
she got thoroughly into shape...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, hey, there's shaved ice! I wanna 
have some as a reward for trying so hard~

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, shaved ice...! I wonder if they have 
apple flavor...?
choice_data_list:
Alright, I'll go buy enough for the three 
of us!
Alright, I'll go get enough for three!

text_block_list.name: Concession Stand Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that! Business is booming 
today so we're fresh out of ice. We're 
waiting on a restock truck right now, but—

text_block_list.name: Concession Stand Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Mm, hello? ...What'd you say!? You got in 
an accident when you're right down the 
street!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!! Oh no!! Everyone's in trouble, 
let's go help them!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh... W-Wait, you're going!?

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Great, getting stuck on the shoulder like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa... Wh-What should I do...? It's all 
Rice's fault for wanting shaved ice...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, right here! Wouldn't it be easier if 
we just lifted the truck? We'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-Yeah...! Um, we'll do it...!!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That truck is fully loaded!? No 
matter how strong an Umamusume is... 
that's a bit much.

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Asking little squirts like you gals for 
help is just, well...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Stand back. Urara, Rice, let's do 
this."

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-Hold on, girls... !?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Aaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text: Uhyaa!? A-Awesomeee...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, we safely managed to get our 
hands on some shaved ice."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin-san was so cool earlier, wasn't 
she~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! You looked so dignified... and 
cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's with you guys all of a 
sudden...?
